'''Desaki''' formally the '''Republic of Desaki''', is a [[Myista country]] located on the southern half of the [[Quia|Quian]] continent. It borders [[United Mihili]] to the west and north, [[Far Lands]] to the north and east, and [[Iareva]] to the West. At [[List of countries and dependencies by area|2,445,136 square kilometres (944,072 sq mi)]], Desaki is the [[List of countries and dependencies by area|13th largest country]] by area, and is the [[Largest country in Quia|fifth-largest country in Quia]]. Its capital is [[Olmurra]], and largest city is [[Velthura]]. Desaki has a [[List of countries and dependencies by population|population of 29 million]], and a low [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|population density of 11.9 inhabitants per square kilometre (30.8/sq mi)]]; 78% of Desakians reside in [[wikipedia:Urban_area|urban areas]]. They are mostly in the border of [[United Mihili]] and the southern half of the country. Desakian urban areas together cover under 0.5% of its land area. Desaki has a [[Desaki climate|diverse climate]] owing to the length of the country.

Desaki has been [[inhabited]] since prehistoric times around 20,000 BFA. The inhabitants emerged as the [[Spol culture]], who were one of the most [[advanced prehistoric peoples]] we know of. The modern people of Desaki did not arrive until the [[7th century]] with the [[Ast-Sirilan conquests]]. The [[Kingdom of Danraa]] was established during the early 11th century, which is seen as the first [[Durnate Kingdom]]. In 1384, [[Athnul]], [[Ethana]] and other [[Desaki cities states|smaller cities states]] on the periphery united to form Desaki. Over the next century Desaki conquered [[Ciniu]], proclaiming [[Ast-Desaki]] in 1483, which remained one of the [[great powers]] of [[Quia]] until the late 16th century It was later involved in the [[Hakushan invasions]], which caused the [[Ast to fall apart in 1590]]. Most of the conquered territories outside the modern Desaki were lost during the 17th centuries. [[Desaki Republic]] was proclaimed in 1595.

'''Desaki''' is a highly developed country in the [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Krali Total Development Index.]] It is a Unitary republic and a [[wikipedia:Parliamentary_system|parliamentary]] democracy, with [[wikipedia:Legislature|legislative power]] vested in the 410-member [[wikipedia:Unicameral|unicameral]]. It is a [[wikipedia:Unitary_state|unitary state]], divided into 24 counties and 314 municipalities. Desaki’s social welfare system that provides [[wikipedia:Universal_health_care|universal health care]] and [[wikipedia:Tertiary_education|tertiary education]] for its citizens. It has the world's 37th highest GDP per capita and ranks very highly in quality of life, health, education, protection of [[wikipedia:Freedom_in_the_World|civil liberties]], economic competitiveness, income equality, gender equality and prosperity. Desaki is in the [[Quian Union]].
